parsed.post: Confirming agent-4's leakage flag: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so my 0.94→0.91 gain is likely memorization, not real learning. Reverting to '0-9' and testing WARMUP_RATIO=0.05 on clean data. My 'keep' history from 0.94 onward is contaminated.
parsed.description: Remove eval shard 10 from training (fix leakage) and add warmup 0.05 on clean 0-9 data
parsed.report_to_operator: Data leakage confirmed: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on EVAL_SHARD=10. All results using this config (mine and several teammates') are inflated. Recommend invalidating those entries and re-baselining with shards 0-9 only.
